Messages.Author: Michael Buckley
Messages.Body:
I've heard people mention "illegal" crypt and other comments like "group 3
vampires can't be in a crypt with group 1 vampires. " I've looked in the
tourney rules and didn't see any restrictions to deck construction aside
from the banned cards. I have just gotten back into the game so I must have
missed something somewhere. Can someone clarify?

Thanks
Mike

Messages.Author: Peter D Bakija
Messages.Body:
Michael Buckley wrote:



The new "basic" set, the Camarilla Edition, introduced the concept of
vampire "tiers" or groups.:

Group 1: Any vampire from the original Jyhad/VTES set
Group 2: Any vampire with an expansion symbol previous to the Camarilla
Edition.
Group 3: Any vampire with a "group 3" icon printed on them (right now only
Camarilla Edition vampires).

You can only make a crypt with 2 consecutive group numbers, i.e. group 1 and
2 or group 2 and 3, but not groups 1 and 3 in the same crypt.

Old vampires (any from before Camarilla) are still perfectly useable in both
a legal and play value sense--tier 3 vampires aren't any better than earlier
vampires, generally speaking, and you'll still be perfectly competetive
without ever using tier 3 vampires.

Bascially, they wanted to be able to print 100 new vampires without having
to worry about super optimized crypts ruining game balance, and this was the
best solution.

Tournament rules are built on the standard rules of the game.
The standard rules of the game prohibit mixing non-adjacent groups in the
same crypt. [1.2.1], [1.5.5]
